name: Selective Breeding Program
description: Establish a systematic breeding program to improve growth rate and disease resistance through genetic selection.

name: Genetic Marker Analysis
description: Use DNA markers to identify superior broodstock traits before breeding, dramatically improving selection accuracy.

name: Advanced Genomic Selection
description: Full genomic profiling enables multi-trait optimization across growth, disease resistance, fillet quality, and color.

name: Disease Resistance Breeding
description: Breed salmon strains with enhanced innate immunity to common Norwegian aquaculture diseases.

name: ISA Resistance Program
description: Develop ISA-resistant salmon strains through targeted breeding. ISA outbreaks can devastate entire farms.

name: Feed Formula Optimization
description: Develop custom feed formulas optimized for Norwegian conditions. Better FCR means lower costs and faster growth.

name: Insect Meal Integration
description: Replace fishmeal with black soldier fly larvae protein. Sustainable, cost-effective, and reduces ocean dependency.

name: Algae-Based Omega-3
description: Supplement feed with microalgae-derived omega-3 fatty acids, reducing reliance on wild fish stocks.

name: Smolt Quality Enhancement
description: Improve hatchery conditions and photoperiod manipulation for stronger, larger smolts with better sea survival.

name: Next-Gen Vaccine Program
description: Develop improved vaccines against PD, IHN, and furunculosis. Reduces mortality and antibiotic dependency.

name: Mechanical Delousing Systems
description: Invest in Hydrolicer and Thermolicer technology for chemical-free sea lice removal. Better for sustainability score.

name: Real-Time Water Quality Monitoring
description: Deploy IoT sensors for continuous oxygen, temperature, salinity, and turbidity monitoring across all sites.

name: Semi-Closed Containment Systems
description: Install semi-closed pen systems that dramatically reduce sea lice, escapes, and environmental impact.

name: Sludge Collection & Recycling
description: Capture and recycle fish waste from net pens. Reduces eutrophication and produces biogas/fertilizer.

name: Renewable Energy Transition
description: Power farm operations with solar, wind, or tidal energy. Reduces carbon footprint and operating costs long-term.

name: Solar Panel Arrays
description: Install solar panels on feed barges and shore facilities. Limited by Norwegian daylight but effective in summer.

name: Offshore Wind Integration
description: Leverage Norway's strong coastal winds to power operations. Excellent synergy with exposed ocean sites.

name: Automated Harvest Systems
description: Deploy robotic harvest equipment for faster, less stressful fish handling. Improves welfare and fillet quality.

name: Cold Chain Optimization
description: Improve temperature-controlled logistics from harvest to market. Reduces spoilage and opens distant export markets.

name: Blockchain Traceability
description: Implement farm-to-fork blockchain tracking. Premium buyers pay more for verified origin and handling data.

name: AI-Driven Feeding Systems
description: Computer vision and appetite sensors optimize feed delivery in real-time. Reduces waste and improves FCR.

name: Underwater ROV Inspection
description: Deploy ROVs for net inspection, mortality removal, and behavioral monitoring without diver risk.

name: AI Health Monitoring
description: Machine learning analyzes fish behavior, swimming patterns, and feeding response to detect disease 3-5 days earlier.

name: Electric Service Vessels
description: Replace diesel workboats with electric vessels. Zero emissions, lower fuel costs, and sustainability points.

name: Hybrid Wellboat Technology
description: Upgrade wellboats to diesel-electric hybrid. Critical for large-scale live fish transport with lower emissions.
